findings.title: Board page cannot retrieve cards after first 15
findings.detail: Board requests 15 cards/column. Unloaded count is a paragraph; Show more only expands the local done-column array. Client exposes no column-card cursor read. Card 16 cannot be found/opened through the column or searched there.
findings.remediation: Implement contract-bound cursor loads with stale refresh and dedupe; test a 31-card column and match beyond first page.

findings.title: Board search/filter ignores unloaded cards and omits priority/column
findings.detail: matches() filters cached arrays; queries never receive changing filters. Result denominator is loaded allCards.length. No priority/column state/control and no project search call exists.
findings.remediation: Use canonical server search/filter counts and cursor queries; expose required priority/column filters. Test filter totals and no-match states with hidden pages.

findings.title: Move uses first-page neighbors and lacks before/after placement
findings.detail: Move top/bottom counts loaded cards and derives neighbors from cached snapshot. Bottom with 31 cards can target after card 15 with null next, causing conflict or wrong intent; no bounded placement read or before/after option.
findings.remediation: Call placement endpoint for first/last/before/after and honor current versions; test real destination with unseen cards in filtered and merged views.

findings.title: Undo can use latest intervening version
findings.detail: Toast undo reads latest cached card.version and submits ordinary move, so an intervening edit that has polled can be accepted and its new order overridden. Dedicated move-undo handler enforces intervening-work checks.
findings.remediation: Bind undo to successful command/result and use backend undo semantics; test teammate edit/move between move and undo.

findings.title: Comment edit/delete/moderation is absent
findings.detail: Rendered comments only show author/time/body. API client exposes list/post only. No user can edit/delete own comment or moderate another through web.
findings.remediation: Implement versioned author edit and authorized delete/moderation with tombstones, confirmation and retry behavior.

findings.title: Board archive/reopen is absent
findings.detail: Project lifecycle controls exist, board lifecycle methods/actions do not. Backend offers board archive/reopen.
findings.remediation: Add Owner/Manager board lifecycle and archived board discovery/reopen; test no card deletion and unchanged trash cutoff.

findings.title: Manager People controls offer forbidden role operations
findings.detail: All non-owner rows expose Manager option and Remove, disabled only for self/pending. A Manager is offered promoting Member to Manager, demoting/removing peer Manager. Server refusal is necessary but misleading controls remain.
findings.remediation: Derive target-aware permissions; Manager only sees Member/Viewer changes/removals and protected peer rows. Verify actual API denial too.

findings.title: Several retries lose logical command identity
findings.detail: Comment rotates key on every error, quick-add has no retained key, invitation creation clears attempt on every error, image retry re-stages with new keys. A committed mutation plus lost response can create duplicate logical work; field patch retry may become stale rather than reconcile. Full add-card and new-project handle retained keys better.
findings.remediation: Retain request payload/key through unknown outcomes; rotate on deliberate new intent or definitive refusal. Reproduce response loss after commit for create/comment/invite/image-finalize, assert one side effect.

findings.title: Drawer Save can partly save fields before status move fails
findings.detail: Save first PATCHes fields then POSTs a move when dropdown changed. If move conflicts, fields already persisted while UI reports save failure and retains/reconciles draft later. Successful save waits for refetch to reset base/dirty.
findings.remediation: Keep status change a separate immediate Move action or show precise partial outcome; reconcile canonical field response immediately. Browser trace delayed save/refetch dirty transitions including assignee save.

findings.title: Overdue dates use browser timezone rather than workspace timezone
findings.detail: startOfToday() uses browser local calendar. No workspace timezone argument exists, so a workspace day and browser day disagreement mislabels due/overdue although YYYY-MM-DD input stays date-only.
findings.remediation: Use server workspaceToday/canonical due state or explicit timezone calendar helper; test same due date in UTC and Asia/Kolkata around midnight.

findings.title: Session error is masked by stale successful data
findings.detail: Session state returns ready whenever query.data exists before checking query.isError. A background 401 retains last successful React Query data, preventing signedOut banner/redirect from activating and leaving stale privileges in UI. Backend still must deny writes.
findings.remediation: Prioritize authentication failure, preserve only safe user drafts, clear protected caches on loss. Browser test successful session then real revoked session/refetch, with and without dirty input.

findings.title: Card drawer modality needs browser accessibility correction/verification
findings.detail: Main drawer has aria-modal and local Tab trap, but unlike DialogLayer does not acquire inert lock for app background. Click/focus and screen-reader background exposure, nested modal return, and tablist arrow keys are unverified. Source lacks tablist keyboard pattern.
findings.remediation: Unify modal stacking/focus/inert behavior and implement tab keyboard navigation; run keyboard and accessibility tree checks.

findings.title: Image list knowingly accepts incompatible response envelopes
findings.detail: Source comment says backend data.items differs from contract data array; cast and fallback obscure broken response contract. No current contract-validated browser response evidence available.
findings.remediation: Choose canonical schema on backend/contracts/client and assert actual response via integrated image flow; avoid permissive casts hiding malformed payloads.

findings.title: Pagination missing across management and feeds
findings.detail: API methods omit cursors; consumers mostly select .data. Activity Load more slices the first 100; card activity first 50; comments/trash/invites/directory/board access lack continuation. Session accessibleProjects itself is treated as complete. Cap effects must be checked against actual contracts before claiming list completeness.
findings.remediation: Keep envelopes, add server cursor loops/load controls and role-loss resets. Use over-page synthetic fixtures for every paginated surface. Verify session project cap/continuation separately.

findings.title: Unsent comment drafts disappear through ordinary drawer/tab transitions
findings.detail: requestClose checks field dirtyRef only. Comments owns local state, conditional Comments/Activity unmounts it. Switching to Activity, closing a field-clean drawer or auto-closing on trash/revocation loses typed comment. No safe draft retention found.
findings.remediation: Track independent drafts above conditional tabs; include comment draft in close protection and preserve safe text when access ends. Test field save, tab change, close/Escape, delete/revoke and reconnect.

findings.title: Profile avatar updates have no UI control
findings.detail: Current account form edits displayName only. Catalogue still requires name/avatar updates. Decide provider-managed avatar expectation explicitly rather than claiming full profile editing.
findings.remediation: Reconcile provider-managed avatar scope or add supported avatar update flow with validation.

findings.title: Activity UI does not implement owner cross-project feed
findings.detail: One active project is selected, even though header says WORKSPACE. No workspace activity client call, card filter or all-owned-project feed. Newer restriction on combined card views may deliberately affect this feature but does not itself retire audit feed.
findings.remediation: Reconcile exact owner audit scope; implement current authorized feed/filter semantics and make heading/counts accurate.

findings.title: Import does not follow asynchronous/current status or full preview
findings.detail: Upload always enters preview using one response; commit always enters done on 2xx; no status GET/poll client. NextCursor is disclosed but cannot load remaining preview. No explicit unknown status mapping UI. Current synchronous backend may mask missing state handling.
findings.remediation: Bind stage to returned state, add bounded status/cursor reads and expiry/cancel/unknown-commit recovery; implement explicit status mapping or document supported correction flow.

findings.title: Import results lack card links, provenance and safe report download
findings.detail: Created rows render title/external ID as text, only Open board link. No import status/report GET, safe download, per-created-card link or batch receipt UI.
findings.remediation: Expose receipt/result/error report endpoints and scoped card links; verify leading formula characters remain text in report.

findings.title: Inbox/tasks/activity/trash do not register foreground refresh
findings.detail: Default window-focus refetch is false. These feed pages do not use usePollKeys, so active tabs do not receive mention/read updates or cleared private previews after grant removal until a fresh fetch/remount/action. Session polling alone does not refresh unregistered feeds.
findings.remediation: Register relevant queries and reconcile revoked authority/clear protected rows; test new mention, other-tab read, board/project revoke with screen left open.

findings.title: Workspace/transfer catalogue rows are retired or shifted
findings.detail: Keep all stable IDs. ACC-04 manual create and ACC-07 transfer are intentionally retired beta operations; ACC-06 maps to own/shared project switcher; ACC-05 workspace preferences remain absent/unreconciled. No automatic verified status is justified.
findings.remediation: Architect records explicit supersession/retirement and revised acceptance/evidence binding for each stable ID; verify 410 negatives and automatic personal-container path.

findings.title: Catalogue access/board settings prose predates explicit board grants
findings.detail: INV-01/RBAC-05 still mention inherited/all boards; current UI explicitly says zero boards until Owner grant. BRD-02 catalogue allows Manager rename but newer B-3 makes name/description Owner-only.
findings.remediation: Preserve stable IDs and update acceptance with latest decisions; obtain current backend/UI/integration evidence against revised semantics.

findings.title: Delete confirmation omits named card and 24-hour recovery window
findings.detail: Delete confirmation says only “Delete this card?” and “The card moves to the trash. Comments and images stay with it.” It omits the title and the explicitly required 24-hour recovery cutoff. Trash page explains 24 hours later, but the destructive decision lacks that context.
findings.remediation: Name the card and state recovery is available for 24 hours subject to server cutoff; verify accessible confirmation text before delete.
